purpose: Deterministic GEMM arithmetic for interpreter and later RTL; no HDL implementation authorization.
lane_order: K increasing; each output column has an independent reduction.
product: FP32 multiplication, round-to-nearest ties-to-even; no fused multiply-add.
K16_reduction: Adjacent balanced binary tree: 16 products -> 8 -> 4 -> 2 -> 1; every addition rounds to FP32 with ties-to-even.
W4_group: Eight K16 tree results accumulated in increasing K order into FP32 group sum initialized to +0; then multiply by stored FP32 group scale with FP32 rounding.
W4_output: Accumulate scaled group results in increasing group order into FP32 output partial sum initialized to +0; preserve across residency tiles and normal command chunks.
BF16_attention: Accumulate K16 tree results in increasing K order in FP32, without group scaling.
tail: Absent K lanes contribute +0 and perform no operand read.
output_rounding: Previously agreed: bias in FP32 before final BF16 nearest-even for QKV; completed unbiased output casts only after full reduction.
FP32_exceptions_subnormals: Pending separate specification and implementation feasibility review.
acceptance: Interpreter and RTL must match this arithmetic contract; original BF16 reference and W4 model quality are separate comparisons, with tolerances still pending.

alternatives.name: sequential K accumulation
alternatives.impact: Different rounding order; longer dependence chain unless interleaved.

alternatives.name: FMA accumulation
alternatives.impact: Different rounding semantics; requires its own golden reference and implementation/resource evaluation.
